name: camera-tunnel-frame-profile
description: Observe bounded whole-workload RenderStepped intervals during the exact eighteen-punch long-tunnel regression. Retains every camera acceptance gate; reports frame percentiles without a fabricated FPS threshold. This measures the entire workload, not isolated camera algorithm cost.

args.code: local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Coins=1000000000,Power=6000,Depth=75,WallLevel=99,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) c:Invoke('BuyFist','Titan Gauntlet') local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local r=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero r.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-20),Vector3.new(-2,3,-400)) p:SetAttribute('LastWallHit',0) return true

local function startFrameObserver(deps)
 local cap,watchdogSeconds=16384,95
 local startedAt=deps.now()
 local samples,connections={},{}
 local totalSeconds,over50,over100,observed,dropped=0,0,0,0,0
 local ended,summary,watchdog=false,nil,nil
 local function finish(reason)
  if ended then return summary end
  ended=true
  local elapsed=deps.now()-startedAt
  if reason=='complete' and elapsed>=watchdogSeconds then reason='watchdog' end
  local disconnectFailures=0
  for _,connection in ipairs(connections) do
   local ok=pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() assert(not connection.Connected,'observer still connected') end)
   if not ok then disconnectFailures+=1 end
  end
  local cancelled=true
  local watchdogPending=watchdog~=nil
  if watchdog then cancelled=pcall(deps.cancel,watchdog) watchdog=nil end
  table.sort(samples)
  local count=#samples
  local function percentile(fraction)
   return count>0 and samples[math.clamp(math.ceil(count*fraction),1,count)] or 0
  end
  summary={contract='CameraTunnelFrameProfileV1',available=true,runId=deps.runId,
   measurement='whole-workload RenderStepped intervals; not isolated camera algorithm cost',
   complete=reason=='complete' and count>0 and dropped==0 and disconnectFailures==0 and cancelled,
   reason=reason,frameCount=count,observedCount=observed,sampledSeconds=totalSeconds,wallSeconds=elapsed,
   p50Ms=percentile(.50),p95Ms=percentile(.95),p99Ms=percentile(.99),maxMs=percentile(1),
   over50Ms=over50,over100Ms=over100,droppedSamples=dropped,sampleCap=cap,
   sampleLimitHit=reason=='overflow',watchdogSeconds=watchdogSeconds,timedOut=reason=='watchdog',
   disconnected=disconnectFailures==0,disconnectFailures=disconnectFailures,watchdogCancelled=watchdogPending and cancelled,watchdogExpired=reason=='watchdog'}
  local published=pcall(deps.publish,summary)
  if not published then summary.complete=false summary.publicationFailed=true end
  return summary
 end
 connections[#connections+1]=deps.render:Connect(function(delta)
  if ended then return end
  observed+=1
  if deps.now()-startedAt>=watchdogSeconds then dropped+=1 finish('watchdog') return end
  if type(delta)~='number' or delta~=delta or delta<=0 or delta==math.huge then
   dropped+=1 finish('invalid_interval') return
  end
  if #samples>=cap then dropped+=1 finish('overflow') return end
  samples[#samples+1]=delta*1000 totalSeconds+=delta
  if delta>.05 then over50+=1 end
  if delta>.1 then over100+=1 end
 end)
 connections[#connections+1]=deps.request:Connect(function()
  local request=deps.readRequest()
  if request==deps.runId..':complete' then finish('complete')
  elseif request==deps.runId..':abort' then finish('cleanup') end
 end)
 connections[#connections+1]=deps.destroying:Connect(function() finish('gui_destroyed') end)
 watchdog=deps.delay(watchdogSeconds,function() watchdog=nil finish('watchdog') end)
 return {finish=finish}
end
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local R=game:GetService('RunService')
assert(R:IsStudio(),'Studio diagnostic only')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=assert(p and p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('PunchWallHUD'),'HUD missing before workload')
assert(g:GetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileActive')~=true,'previous frame observer still active')
local runId=H:GenerateGUID(false)
g:SetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileRunId',runId)
g:SetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileJSON',nil)
g:SetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileRequest',nil)
g:SetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileActive',true)
local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
local viewport=camera and camera.ViewportSize
local startViewport=viewport and {x=viewport.X,y=viewport.Y} or nil
startFrameObserver({runId=runId,now=os.clock,render=R.RenderStepped,
 request=g:GetAttributeChangedSignal('CameraTunnelFrameProfileRequest'),destroying=g.Destroying,
 readRequest=function() return g:GetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileRequest') end,
 delay=task.delay,cancel=task.cancel,publish=function(summary)
  summary.viewportStart=startViewport
  local finalCamera=workspace.CurrentCamera
  local finalViewport=finalCamera and finalCamera.ViewportSize
  summary.viewportEnd=finalViewport and {x=finalViewport.X,y=finalViewport.Y} or nil
  summary.initialWindowFocus='unknown; this observer does not establish foreground state'
  summary.recoveryCountersAvailable=false
  local raw=g:GetAttribute('CameraAutomationRecoveryJSON')
  if type(raw)=='string' then
   local ok,value=pcall(function() return H:JSONDecode(raw) end)
   local last=ok and type(value)=='table' and value.last
   if type(last)=='table' then
    summary.recoveryCountersAvailable=true
    summary.recovery={searchesSinceReset=last.recoverySearches,cacheHitsSinceReset=last.recoveryCacheHits,
     lastSearchCandidates=last.recoveryCandidates,lastSearchSweeps=last.recoverySweeps,
     lastReason=last.recoverySearchReason,remaining=last.remaining}
   end
  end
  local encoded=H:JSONEncode(summary)
  assert(#encoded<3900,'frame profile exceeds runner evidence bound')
  print('[SMASH_CAMERA_TUNNEL_FRAME_PROFILE_V1]'..encoded)
  g:SetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileJSON',encoded)
  g:SetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileActive',false)
 end})
return H:JSONEncode({armed=true,runId=runId,sampleCap=16384,watchdogSeconds=95})

local function compactCameraResult(result)
 local summary={}
 if type(result)~='table' then return {valid=false,reason='missing_camera_result'} end
 for key,value in pairs(result) do
  local kind=type(value) if kind=='boolean' or kind=='number' or kind=='string' then summary[key]=value end
 end
 summary.visualFailureReasons=result.visualFailureReasons
 summary.visibilityPhases=result.visibilityPhases
 return summary
end

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=assert(p and p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('PunchWallHUD'),'HUD missing after workload')
local runId=assert(g:GetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileRunId'),'frame observer was not armed')
g:SetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileRequest',runId..':complete')
local deadline=os.clock()+5
local raw
repeat raw=g:GetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileJSON') if not raw then task.wait(.02) end until raw or os.clock()>=deadline
assert(type(raw)=='string','frame observer did not export/disconnect before deadline')
local summary=H:JSONDecode(raw)
assert(summary.runId==runId and summary.complete==true and summary.disconnected==true and summary.frameCount>0 and summary.droppedSamples==0 and summary.timedOut==false,
 'frame observation incomplete '..raw)
return raw

steps.label: finish frame observation and export tagged console evidence

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p and p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('PunchWallHUD')
local runId=g and g:GetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileRunId')
if not g or not runId then return H:JSONEncode({available=false,complete=false,reason='observer_not_armed'}) end
local raw=g:GetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileJSON')
if not raw then
 g:SetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileRequest',runId..':abort')
 local deadline=os.clock()+5
 repeat raw=g:GetAttribute('CameraTunnelFrameProfileJSON') if not raw then task.wait(.02) end until raw or os.clock()>=deadline
end
if type(raw)~='string' then return H:JSONEncode({available=false,complete=false,disconnected=false,reason='cleanup_export_unavailable',runId=runId}) end
assert(#raw<3900,'cleanup frame profile exceeds runner evidence bound')
local summary=H:JSONDecode(raw)
assert(summary.runId==runId,'stale frame profile export')
return raw
